details:
I am having an issue with the Creator Economy Store Manager.

Several of my worlds already have World Stores created, but they do not appear in my Store Manager list and I cannot select them under my listing's Store Availability.

When I try:

Marketplace → My Store → Store Manager → Setup New Store → World Store → Select World → Create

it fails and says:

"Failed to create store! Store already exists"

This confirms the store already exists, but I cannot access or manage it. The worlds are uploaded correctly and already have my Udon products/roles set up. Some of my other World Stores appear normally, but these ones are missing. and many others what i add. is there a limit? it just says failed and all ready there yet never shows on the list to enable them, and never shows on the product list to add the roles.

Could you please check my account and reset/fix the stuck World Store entries so they appear in Store Manager?
title: bug issues with store manager
